open_knowledge_format.integration: Canonical Article serialization contract. Small YAML framing and timestamp-preserving loader adapted from src/reference_agent/bundle/document.py into harness/knowledge/format.py with attribution. No reference-agent runtime, ADK, Gemini service, or second knowledge store.

markdownify.integration: Installed dependency underneath the existing web.fetch Capability; preserves structured HTML as Markdown and resolves safe outgoing links, without crawling.

markdown_it_py.integration: Installed CommonMark parser for Article link extraction, reference-style links, and review evidence locations. Code examples, images, and external URLs do not become Article edges.

watchdog.integration: Installed Python dependency; one in-process Linux inotify observer for Source incoming closed-write and atomic-move events. No upstream daemon or polling service.

smart_turn_v3_2_cpu.integration: Drop-in ONNX for Pipecat's LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3 in the speech worker's Smart Turn gate (CPU), replacing the bundled v3.1 (sha256 fb68d55c2d542ce79e44b12013bfd571e90df8594ab096d757198e851b0c6594) after offline replay; realtime_smart_turn_model = "bundled" selects v3.1.

wayshot.integration: One PNG on stdout for an exact output name or Hyprland stable toplevel identifier; no picker, portal, clipboard, notification, persistence, or service

httpx_sse.integration: Installed maintained SSE decoder for the existing HTTPX model provider. Incremental provider progress uses the existing Task request, cancellation and output limits; no automatic reconnect, generation replay, new model owner or speech transport.

trafilatura.integration: Installed pure HTML article extractor underneath the existing web.fetch Capability. Extracts article text, attribution, date and safe outgoing references from already acquired HTML; sparse or unmarked documents keep Markdownify. No upstream fetcher, crawler, CLI, agent, scheduler or Source owner is used.

areev_diagnostic_patterns.integration: Pattern reference only; no upstream source code, runtime or dependency imported. Native implementation of bounded context inclusion/omission accounting and revision-scoped historical failure diagnostics; deterministic tests of the existing intent/result crash boundaries. Existing Article ontology, tokenizer, execution ledger, Check, review and no-replay owners remain authoritative.

autosaddler_evaluation_patterns.integration: Design reference for the independently implemented Runbook evaluator in execution/evaluation.py and refinement.py. Exact paired coverage, immutable identities, independent held-out criteria, no regressions and strict improvement remain required. The separate native Executive integration uses the upstream engine as recorded in autosaddler_v2.

cpython_sqlite3_compatibility.integration: Use the installed standard-library driver with serialized SQLite and cached_statements=0 on the shared Index connection. Avoid concurrent prepared-statement reuse while preserving existing write transactions and Source lock ownership. No upstream code, extra connection, dependency, retry service or database migration added.

pyyaml_libyaml_parser.integration: Use the installed optional CSafeLoader in existing OKF and strict Source parsers, falling back to SafeLoader. No new dependency or global monkeypatch. Preserve OKF timestamp spellings, duplicate Source-key rejection, and unchanged safe_dump serialization. No trust or integrity verdict is cached.

jsonschema.integration: Validate the complete code-owned argument schema before native Tool dispatch, including conditional variants and limits beyond the advertised model-facing schema vocabulary.

d3_force_3d.integration: Existing installed 3D force engine: taxonomy and relationship springs, sibling-branch charge and node collision. One recursive branch rule derives layer-specific angular space from descendants and distributes outer Articles through local contact plus continuous spherical neighbor repulsion using the installed many-body force. The sphere fits population and physical clearance automatically, with a common first layer and intermediate Articles at their actual depth. The radialout tree example is a design reference; no second renderer or graph runtime is added.

nvidia_ml_py.integration: NVIDIA maintained NVML bindings for demand-driven free VRAM and deduplicated compute/graphics process accounting under the existing model owner. One owned NVML lifetime, no polling service or model/runtime change.

llama_memory_estimator.integration: Installed llama-fit-params --fit-print on estimates full GPU model/context/compute memory from the exact configured profile; cached by artifact/profile/launcher identity. Does not fit down context, change precision, run inference or offload layers.

autosaddler_v2.integration: Pinned upstream AutoSaddler V2 engine, component-map candidates and durable optimization journal. Obsidience supplies Executive and specialist evaluators, receipt-bound contract cases, training-only prompts and the existing model reservation provider. Heimdall Audit is the sole improvement Task. Native session retries and bounded candidate budgets apply to isolated evaluations. Owner-authorized validated instruction bodies publish through the existing Review writer after completed Audit receipt checks. Code and unsupported cases require Review; no live action replay, extra scheduler or provider SDK is installed.

gemma4_template_scan_correction.integration: Small patch to the already installed Gemma chat template: use the immediate next message when it is not a Tool result, and stop both forward scans after resolution. Uses the pinned llama.cpp Jinja loop controls. Prompt bytes were identical for the complete migrated dialogue, Tool exchange and assistant continuation probes. No tokenizer, model, reasoning, schema, special-token or context-setting change. Apply only to the exact recorded template preimage.

hindsight.integration: Separate local PostgreSQL/pgvector memory server; CPU embeddings and FlashRank reranking. The ADK Executive loop takes bounded automatic recall through the Obsidience memory port. Supported async retain operation IDs, webhooks, memory graph/list APIs and immutable Source handoffs replace the ordinary Temporary-memory writer. Native world, experience and observation types retain their perspective and provenance; background mental models can check raw source facts. The read-only Memory pane consumes native graph identities separately from accepted Articles. The ADK conversation log and its provider window own live conversation/context; Alexandria Curate and owner Review own durable wiki recommendations. Extraction, consolidation and optional reflection use the native configured provider. No coding-agent git-history importer, second wiki or second memory owner is mounted.

cordis_reference.usage: Supported Cordis integration patterns inspected; its opinionated coding wiki/runtime is not installed or copied.

patches.purpose: Run native read-only graph projection, schema validation and JSON serialization in a worker thread; retain the exact SQL, public schema, nodes, edges, dates and ownership.

Expose a local FlashRank ONNX intra-op thread setting with spinning disabled when configured; carry the existing request cancellation token into CPU microbatch checkpoints. Preserve the reranker model, 512-token limit, candidate budgets, scoring pipeline and prior graph patch. Apply after 0001. Batch size uses the existing native configuration option. The cancellable FlashRank path applies upstream's per-candidate token cap (0.10.3) itself, because it bypasses the base predict().

Honor OpenRouter daily free-quota epoch-millisecond reset metadata through the existing native ProviderRateLimitResetError and deferred-operation scheduler. Preserve recall, queue identity and retry budget; no additional timer or provider.

Keep the recall anchor's UTC offset on a date parsed from the query ("on Friday", "two days ago", "October 8"), so its one-day window is the owner's local day instead of the same calendar date in UTC. Callers without an offset-aware anchor are unchanged.

Permit same-bank recalled observation updates in the exact default combined scope when relevance-limited per-fact recall omitted the target. Preserve alternate-scope guards, source checks, liveness, locking and native provenance.

Classify native retain facts from the bank agent's perspective by the substantive actor, keeping external assistant reports and genuine bank-agent actions distinct. Update prompt and structured-schema descriptions consistently; preserve enum values, source attribution, uncertainty and conversion logic.

Place the qualified memory text before its dates and provenance context in native cross-encoder input. Preserve the stored text, dates, context, types, candidate and token budgets, cancellation and score handling. Apply after 0002.

Resolve a detected bounded temporal window into calendar-date text for the cross-encoder query only. Preserve the original retrieval query, parsed offset, stored memories, candidate budgets and ranking score contract. Apply after 0002.

Expand an explicitly named month-only dateparser match to the first and last days of its resolved month. Preserve the parsed year and reference offset; explicit day, year, relative and pre-existing range paths remain unchanged. Apply after 0004.

Bound Codex streaming by separate 64 MiB incoming wire bytes, 4 Mi-character line and generated-string-delta ceilings. Preserve the request wall deadline and semantic parsers; do not count SSE framing as generated output. Reject with numeric-only counters and retain native operation retry semantics.

flashrank.integration: CPU ONNX reranker for the optional local Hindsight server, in its isolated environment.

codebase_memory_mcp.integration: Optional read-only Code pane consumes the local MCP provider native /api/layout graph and positions; obsidience-code-graph.service keeps that unmodified provider's permanent daemon and viewer running through its own `daemon start`. Public Codex and Claude Code tool receipts supply exact activity identities through a bounded journal adapter. The derived index stays outside Vault and Source; no graph store, MCP owner, model, ADR or installer hook is added. Obsidience uses its existing Three.js renderer, not a copied upstream UI.

nodeterm.integration: Optional Terminal-pane AGENT CANVAS provider. The unmodified Server Edition runs as obsidience-shell-agent-canvas.service on loopback 127.0.0.1:8770 from an immutable generation under ~/.local/opt/obsidience-agent-canvas; nodeterm owns its canvas state, password login and dedicated tmux server (tmux -L node-terminal), whose sessions survive service restarts by upstream KillMode=process contract. The Shell only presents the page in a WebEngineView with a named persistent profile. Local build deviation: the server bundle marks ssh2's optional cpu-features native module external (ssh2 loads it inside try/catch). Personal, non-hosted use under the Additional Use Grant; no nodeterm code is copied into Obsidience.

nemo_voice_agent.integration: Existing Pipecat ASR and turn-taking dependency. Local patch moves blocking transcription off the audio event loop; one lock retains streaming-cache, VAD-reset and model-replacement serialization, and cancellation drains in-flight native work. No additional recognizer or audio owner.

ffmpeg_camera_capture.integration: Installed native executable through a bounded V4L2 video-only adapter. One selected physical camera frame in memory, CPU PNG conversion, joined child cancellation, no daemon, audio capture, power control or copied upstream source.

opencv_owner_recognition.integration: CPU YuNet detection and SFace embeddings under the existing Realtime camera lease. Owner opt-in enrollment stores private embeddings only; frames remain ephemeral. No authentication or GPU model.

wifi_lab_camera_reuse.integration: Optional pure CPU PersonDetector/ImageTracker reuse for continuous person framing, with owner identification kept separate. Persistent OBSBOT SDK motor connection adapted from the local helper. Does not start room sensing, Kinect or CSI. Light inventory is private configuration; bounded WiZ power control preserves verified appearance separately.

sdk.name: OBSBOT Device SDK
sdk.source: Existing local vendor SDK; no vendor binaries copied into project source
sdk.integration: One parent-owned persistent Tiny2Lite motor helper; continuous proportional velocity control, actual pose feedback, bounded local motor range and stop on expired input. Native AI stays disabled while software owns the motors.

llama_cpp_executive_jinja_scope.integration: Only common/jinja/runtime.cpp moves the unused per-item context copy into the filtered-loop branch, matching current upstream for_statement behavior. Exact real-request parsed JSON parity verified. All other installed artifacts, including target/draft execution and CUDA kernels, match the original b10078 bytes. No template, tokenizer, model, context, precision or GPU changes.

llama_cpp_executive_admission.integration: Selected 2026-10-08. Only the exact-input admission patch is carried (rebased, behaviour unchanged); the Jinja filter-scope fix is upstream (#29776). Launcher adds --no-reasoning-preserve (keeps b10078 prompt bytes) and --checkpoint-min-step 1024 (#28302 fixed the eviction behind the old 0 setting). Measured live: cold 39.7K-token prefill 26.9 s at min-step 0 vs 15.6 s at 1024 (b10078: 28.0 s); warm simple turns 1.56-1.66 s vs 1.79-2.01 s on b10078; VRAM 17,716 MiB. /v1/models now requires the API key (#26347); the Harness health probe sends it.

llama_cpp_executive_g4grammar.integration: Selected 2026-10-09 for obsidience-gemma (llm.sh). The admission build plus json-schema-to-grammar emitting Gemma 4 value syntax, used by the Gemma 4 parser for Tool arguments (the upstream TODO). Enums, constants, ranges, formats, patterns and required keys are now decoder-enforced; output parsing is unchanged. Trade-offs: required keys are generated first, and length/pattern-bounded strings cannot contain '<'. The embedding service keeps llama_cpp_executive_admission. Rollback: the previous LLAMA path in llm.sh.

embeddinggemma_2_text_bf16_gguf.integration: Text-only (270M) EmbeddingGemma 2 converted by ggml-org from the exact upstream revision; served unmodified by the pinned llama_cpp_executive_admission engine (obsidience/scripts/embed.sh, obsidience-embeddings.service) on 127.0.0.1:8791 /v1/embeddings, CPU only (CUDA hidden), 8,192-token sequences, mean pooling, BF16 on avx512_bf16. One resident model shared by the Knowledge index and Hindsight; clients apply the model-card prefixes ('task: search result | query: ', 'title: {title|none} | text: '). Measured 2026-10-09: cosine 1.00000 vs sentence-transformers float32, 9 ms p50 single query, 24.7 memories/s; 768-d full width (MRL 512 ranked slightly lower). No vision/audio projector installed.

hassil.integration: Whole affirmative single light on/off and browser media-pause command parsing in the existing Executive controller; the capability core retains grants, cancellation, receipts and fresh device or media-session verification. Named media phrases only filter current metadata. No Home Assistant server, conversation owner or model.

searxng.integration: Unmodified upstream container run as the rootless Podman Quadlet user service obsidience-searxng (~/.config/containers/systemd/obsidience-searxng.container), published only on 127.0.0.1:8888 with a read-only local settings.yml enabling the JSON API. The existing web.search Capability queries it over HTTP and keeps DDGS as fallback; no SearXNG code is copied or linked.

llama_cpp_executive_admission_b10078_rol.integration: Rollback engine (selected until 2026-10-08). Builds on the separately recorded Jinja scope correction. Adds an optional exact input_token_limit check after complete native tokenization and media expansion but before task creation or queue admission. Explicit pre_enqueue overflow and accepted count/limit headers let the native Executive avoid duplicate preflight rendering/tokenization. Only a verified pre-enqueue refusal can project earlier recoverable read pages and retry once; no retry after admitted inference. Only the server implementation library differs from the Jinja-scope runtime. CUDA kernels, common library, model, template, F16 KV, 65536-token saved profile, MTP3 and vision settings remain unchanged. Experimental MTP-cap, ExLlamaV3 and BeeLlama changes are not installed.

google_adk.integration: Model/Tool loop of the Executive and every specialist Task. One Runner per activation over one SqliteSessionService file (state/adk-sessions.sqlite3) that owns the Executive conversations; specialist Tasks, runs without a conversation and AutoSaddler evaluation trials use an in-memory session for that run only. One BasePlugin carries Obsidience loop policy for any accountable Agent and the shared native projection in before_model_callback; one BaseTool per granted capability runs the shared capability core (receipts, uncertain-effect rules, completion authority). The conversation window and Hindsight recall bound the prompt. No ADK memory, artifact, A2A, Gemini or event-compaction service is used.

google_genai.integration: ADK's Content/Part vocabulary only (google-adk dependency); Part.part_metadata carries Obsidience source kinds. No Gemini API client is constructed.

litellm.integration: ADK's official LiteLlm model route to the served local model id over its OpenAI-compatible endpoint (same version as Hindsight; installed with hash verification). LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True; debug info and telemetry off. The model lease, input-token accounting and projection stay with Obsidience.

aiosqlite.integration: Backend of ADK's SqliteSessionService for the ADK Executive conversation store only.

gpu_screen_recorder_static.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 for obsidience-shell-screen-replay@<output>.service (rolling replay buffers read by computer.replay); run as a separate program, not linked into Obsidience. The upstream static build links the FFmpeg that negotiates the NVENC API at runtime: the system FFmpeg 9.0.1 requires NVENC API 13.1 (driver 610+) and the pinned 580 driver has 13.0. bin/gsr-kms-server is a symlink to the packaged /usr/bin/gsr-kms-server 6.1.2 (cap_sys_admin=ep; capabilities apply through the symlink). Measured on the Samsung: HEVC 30 fps, one NVENC session on the RTX 4080 at ~14% encoder load, ~3% CPU, HDR tone-mapped to SDR bt709.

sunshine.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 as the host of the PC-hosted TV: obsidience-tv-sunshine.service runs the unmodified distribution package as a separate program against obsidience/tv/host/sunshine.conf. It connects only to the TV session's headless compositor (wlr capture, NVENC HEVC at 3840x2160 on the RTX 4080 that renders that compositor; adapter_name and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pin it) and the TV's private PipeWire server, so it cannot capture the desktop or change desktop audio; keyboard, mouse and controller input are disabled, and the libvirtualhid devices it creates anyway are parked on a separate udev seat (72-obsidience-tv-seat.rules, input-check). Paired clients, web credentials and state stay in ~/.config/sunshine.

sway.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 as the TV session compositor only: obsidience-tv-session.service runs the unmodified distribution package headless (WLR_BACKENDS=headless, one 3840x2160@60 output, rendered on the RTX 4080 with --unsupported-gpu) with obsidience/tv/host/sway.conf. It holds only TV content and never replaces or joins the Hyprland desktop session.

streamlink.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 for the TV tuner: obsidience-tv-tuner.service (obsidience/tv/host/tuner.py, system Python) imports the unmodified distribution package as a library and uses its Pluto plugin to open a live channel, mux its separate video and audio with the system ffmpeg and drop the advertisement segments. Beyond the public session, plugin and stream API the tuner takes a muxed stream's readers as its substreams open, reads their is_paused(), releases the muxer's pipes and reaps its process on close, and re-points one Pluto plugin instance by its url setter; check those after a package update (obsidience/tv/host/README.md).

pywayland.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 for the TV remote: obsidience-tv-remote.service (obsidience/tv/host/remote.py, system Python) imports the unmodified distribution package as its Wayland client library, as a client of the TV session's compositor only. The package has no binding for zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1 (wlroots' virtual-keyboard-unstable-v1, which the TV session's sway implements), so remote.py declares that protocol's two interfaces and their requests itself through pywayland's protocol_core classes; no code or protocol text is copied. After a package update check that the unit still starts and types (obsidience/tv/host/README.md).

snapcast.version: 0.35.0 (built from the AUR recipe snapcast 0.35.0-1 with PipeWire support, installed as a pacman package; Snapper 362-364)
snapcast.integration: Selected 2026-10-12 for the Executive's voice on the television in step with the desk speakers: obsidience-tv-voice-server.service runs the unmodified snapserver with obsidience/tv/host/voice/snapserver.conf (its PipeWire source is the sink obsidience_tv_voice), obsidience-tv-voice-desk.service the unmodified snapclient on the Executive's speaker, and obsidience/tv/host/voice.py only moves the speech worker's stream onto that sink while a reply is spoken. The package's own system units stay disabled.

snapdroid.integration: Sideloaded unmodified on the registered television as the Snapcast client that plays the Executive's voice through the television's speakers. It finds the server by mDNS and needs the server's stream port 1704 and control port 1705 (ufw admits only the television).

moonlight_android.integration: Unmodified upstream release APK sideloaded on the Fire TV (package com.limelight) as the display client of the PC-hosted TV; paired with the Sunshine host. Client settings chosen for television, not games: 4K, 60 FPS, 80 Mbps, frame pacing 'Prefer smoothest video', connection warnings off. Local copy: ~/backups/obsidience-tv-moonlight-20261012/apk/.

waydroid_android_tv_image.version: 20260403 (Android TV 16, LineageOS 23.0; VANILLA system and MAINLINE vendor, x86_64)
waydroid_android_tv_image.license: GPL-3.0 (build repository); the images are AOSP/LineageOS (Apache-2.0 and others) and carry proprietary Widevine L3 and ARM translation libraries
waydroid_android_tv_image.integration: Staged 2026-10-12 as the Android TV instance of the PC-hosted TV. Unmodified release images (archive digests as GitHub reports them for the release assets; no signature, one maintainer) mounted read-only from ~/.local/share/obsidience-tv-android/images into the obsidience-tv-android container. Only that container uses them; TFT's Waydroid and /var/lib/waydroid are separate and untouched. Contract and measurements: obsidience/tv/host/README.md.

waydroid_tv_container.version: 1.6.3 (Arch package waydroid 1.6.3-1 with lxc 1:7.0.0-2, inside the container image)
waydroid_tv_container.integration: Unmodified distribution packages (waydroid, socat, dbus) in a rootful Podman container kept in its own store under ~/.local/share/obsidience-tv-android/containers. Obsidience code is the Containerfile and the entrypoint only: a private cgroup namespace with PID 1 in init.scope so LXC's payload lands inside the container's scope, a private binderfs, device nodes reduced to the integrated GPU's render node, private system and session buses, the session run as the owner of the TV compositor's socket, and an ADB relay to Android's fixed address. No Waydroid or image file is patched; the host's waydroid package and TFT's instance are not used.

smarttube.integration: Unmodified publisher release APK (x86 build, runs without ARM translation) installed by ADB in the Android TV instance; its v1 and v2 signer is the certificate pinned for the television's copy. Install an update only when it carries that certificate. Local copy: ~/.local/share/obsidience-tv-android/apps/.

jellyfin_catalogue.integration: Optional catalogue through supported authenticated Items/System REST reads. Official unmodified rootless container, read-only media roots, no GPU devices; server owns catalogue and client delivery independently of television; existing tuner/mpv owns only the TV destination. Unit: obsidience/media/obsidience-media-jellyfin.container. No Jellyfin code copied. Media feature defaults disabled. Native M3U live television uses curated broadcaster sources; no additional plugin.

tiramisu.integration: Optional native FUSE provider. Local patch replaces control and embedded engine TCP with owner-only Unix sockets, limits public operations, exposes actual reader readiness, disables LAN dashboard discovery and SMB watchdog in private mode, and drains readers before ordinary unmount. No lazy unmount, service restart loop, NAT mapping or scheduler. Unmodified torrent/FUSE implementation; copied license and module manifest accompany binary. Disk warmup disabled because pinned eviction does not protect live readers; bounded memory streaming cache only. Private mode parses strict JSON and rejects malformed configuration before starting providers.

prowlarr_discovery.integration: Unmodified official standalone release, used only as source discovery behind its authenticated loopback API. Initial public indexer is built-in TorrentsCSV. No download client, Arr automation stack, RSS acquisition or watchlist. API key supplied privately through a systemd credential.
